chapter: This Is Your Life and film work
title: Her Universal short with Ina Ray Hutton
summary: She made a short film with Ina Ray Hutton's all-girl band, singing Real Gone Guy, around 1953-54.

bands.name: Ina Ray Hutton and Her Orchestra

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Somebody told me that they saw a piece of film with you. What would that have been?

Oh, I did a short with Ina Ray Hutton, Ina Ray Hutton and her Girl -- I think it was called, "No Men Allowed," or something like that, because she had all girls, you know, an all girl orchestra. And she was a charming person, I thought. She sort of faded out of the picture. I don't know what happened to Ina Ray, but I did do this with her for Universal.

Oh, because there's a book out called, Jazz On Film, * and your name isn't listed in it, but they do have some of the Universal shorts listed in there. Yet somebody told me they saw this short with you in it.
Do you remember what you did in it?

Yes, I did, "Real Gone Guy." I've got to find out about that, because I tell you, you see, I wasn't a member of the Screen Actors Guild, and this was one of the things that I did -- Taft-Hartley, you know, the Taft-Hartley thing, where they allow you to do one thing, see, because it
was filmed. I think it was probably the beginning of some of the things that were done on film for television, you know.

Not for television particularly, but they did them in theaters like short subjects, you know. They used to call them short subjects. I don't know if they still call them that, because I don't know -- I don't really go to theaters that much. I don't like what's happening with some of the things, you know, on the screen, so I don't frequent the theater scenes too much now.
What year did you make this?
This must have been about -- it was in the '50s. It had to be in the '50s, because I'm just thinking, it had to be maybe about '50 -- '53, '54, something like that. It had to be around that time.
